## Summary

Atmospheric bar & timeclub at Nikolaou Rossou 1, Larnaca 6020, Cyprus. Open daily 17:00 – 02:00. 50+ board games, craft cocktails, catering, and private event hire. Phone: +357 95 147376. Email: mail@daerdree.bar.
